settings.question: How do I take Lymphgem?
settings.answer: Take one softgel a day with breakfast and a glass of water. Each pouch holds 30 softgels, a full 60-day supply.

settings.question: What’s inside each softgel?
settings.answer: Cleavers 100mg, red clover 75mg, stillingia root 60mg and prickly ash bark 65mg (all 20:1 extracts, a 6,000mg herb equivalent), Pycnogenol® French maritime pine bark 150mg, Centella asiatica TTFCA 60mg and selenium 100mcg. All in MCT coconut oil inside a vegan softgel.

settings.question: What does Lymphgem do?
settings.answer: Lymphgem supports your body’s natural lymphatic flow and healthy circulation, so you feel lighter and less puffy as part of a daily routine.*

settings.question: Why a softgel instead of drops?
settings.answer: You get the same four classic lymph herbs without the dropper, the bitter taste or the guesswork. Every softgel is pre-measured, travels anywhere and adds 150mg Pycnogenol® and 60mg Centella, which most drops don’t have.

settings.question: When will I notice a difference?
settings.answer: Botanical support builds with consistency. Take Lymphgem every day for at least 4 to 8 weeks, alongside plenty of water and daily movement.*

settings.question: Is Lymphgem vegan?
settings.answer: Yes. The softgel shell is vegan with no gelatin and no beeswax, and every ingredient sits in MCT coconut oil.

settings.question: Is Lymphgem safe to take every day?
settings.answer: Lymphgem is made for daily use. Talk to your doctor first if you are pregnant or nursing, take medication (especially blood thinners) or have a hormone-sensitive condition, since red clover contains plant estrogens. And if it’s not right for you, you’re covered by our 60-day money-back guarantee.

settings.question: How much do I take?
settings.answer: 2 mL a day, about half a teaspoon. Fill the dropper, then hold it under your tongue or add it to a little water. One bottle gives you 30 servings.

settings.question: Is it safe with my medication?
settings.answer: Ask your doctor before you start if you take any medication, are pregnant or nursing, or have a medical condition. Store it out of children's reach.

settings.question: Why not just take milk thistle?
settings.answer: Milk thistle on its own covers one base. These drops pair it with NAC, L-glutathione, dandelion, artichoke, beet root and choline, so you get them together in one serving rather than buying each one separately.

settings.question: How long should I take it for?
settings.answer: It is made for everyday, ongoing use as part of a healthy routine. Results vary from person to person.

settings.question: Is it free from common allergens?
settings.answer: It contains no soy, dairy, gluten or tree nuts and is non-GMO. The active ingredients are botanicals (milk thistle, dandelion, artichoke, beet root), choline and amino acids. Check the Supplement Facts label for the complete list.

settings.question: How do I store it?
settings.answer: Close the cap tightly and keep it somewhere cool and dry. Slight color differences between bottles are natural.

settings.question: What if it doesn't work for me?
settings.answer: You're covered by our 60-day money-back guarantee. Reach us through our Contact page and see the refund policy for details.
